source_observations: 来源身份来自all_videos_tag.xlsx和video_mapping.csv，颜色不作为材料依据。
深色近侧视平板条被上下真实夹口夹持，未见金属式塑性颈缩。
下夹口上方暴露段有局部曲折损伤，侧视投影与测量附件遮挡使准确断面结构难确认。
事件附近上方自由端出现轻微侧偏；测量附件断后摆开，不能视为试样飞动。
observations: All600 evaluated frames measured; geometry observations are in technical_checks. Final video visual inspection and user acceptance are recorded separately in SHA-bound records.
No material clamp path after measured whole-seam rupture; both fragments remain attached to their respective jaw.
Entire measured oblique seam stays outside lower authored gauge boundary and above lower clamp root.
Supplemental all600 evaluated frames confirm actual entire oblique fracture remains in the selected position class.
Static scene.blend stores frame600 geometry; frame_set does not reconstruct this programmatic animation.
Technical qualification of the time value is separate from this coupled-candidate qualification.
modelling_assumptions: 所有尺寸均为无量纲作者相对几何，未由来源毫米标尺标定。
固定相机与理想真实夹口接触；设备柔度和真实控制延迟未求解。
采用参考约束的定性几何动画，不是有限元、本构预测或标准符合性证明。
中央60%作为作者模拟标距，不代表来源正式标距。
完整板条用无纤维纹理的等效连续固体表达，具体破坏组分未知。
近下端低倾角斜裂面为作者几何近似；上裂面局部x方向剪切0.12表达来源轻微侧偏，未标定幅度。
破断后停止加载与几何运动是DESIGN选择的试验条件，不声称原实验完全静止。
后板按用户反馈移除，孤立设备柱按独立复核移除；夹口与固定相机保留，采用夹具与试样视图。
破断后停止加载与运动是选定生成条件，不声称来源设备和附件完全静止。
Stage1 changes are uncalibrated qualitative author parameters; source does not measure these candidate values.
Discrete candidate changes do not establish continuous accepted ranges.
unknowns: 材料牌号、基体、纤维种类、纤维方向、铺层数/织构。
真实厚度、宽度、正式标距、载荷、伸长率和横梁柔度。
真实三维裂面/界面路径、控制延迟与可恢复能量。
来源侧视及遮挡不能证实微观纤维断裂或完整层合结构。

technical_checks.scope: 600 evaluated mesh frames: graph paths, closed edges, signed volume, tracked material lengths and intact section, actual bevelled jaws, interface and seam-plane clearance; no full triangle self-intersection or constitutive solver
technical_checks.contact_semantics: intentional jaw embed0.48; evaluated inner planes and outer material measured

all_frame_summary.position_guard: entire fracture endpoints and full sinusoidal debond support constrained in initial material coordinates; actual fracture extrema measured each frame
all_frame_summary.length_definition: tracked outer material edge path for each future fragment; gauge length is axial projection between initial z=-1.5,+1.5 prior to rupture
all_frame_summary.intact_section_definition: same initial material section at z=1.5, outside fracture/opening region
all_frame_summary.volume_interpretation: fixed thickness and prescribed axial stretch, small volume increase is authored geometric approximation; not incompressibility
all_frame_summary.two_prefracture_measurements_equal_reaso: abrupt whole seam failure and simultaneous interface opening; both events measured at same onset frame

supplemental_whole_damage_measurement.method: evaluated mesh source_coordinate attributes; full support endpoint vertices exist and have zero y displacement; all nonzero opening vertices stay within full support; zero opening outside support; all measured oblique fracture extrema retain position class
